parts.method: Closed two-lamina surface interpolated through the existing anatomical fan paths, with a tapered belly, broad attachment rims, and thin tendinous ends.
limitations: Model-derived reconstruction; this part is not a segmented BodyParts3D mesh.
Attachment paths and wrapping guides are inherited from the existing rig; their anatomical limitations remain.
Thickness and edge spread are display estimates, not measured tissue geometry, PCSA, or a tissue deformation law.

parts.method: Overlapping short closed lamellar slips along the existing lumbar, thoracic, and cervical multifidus paths.

Slip width and thickness are display estimates and do not alter the physical paths or maximum muscle force.
